conbody.p: The following section describes how X-Author for Contracts Advanced works with the Conga Platform and how you can manage your organization's and your customers' contracts.

entry.p: This user guide shows an entire contract lifecycle inside Microsoft Word while complying with approval workflows and using the latest terms and clauses from your clause library. It covers step-by-step instructions and use cases for the features provided by X-Author for Contracts.
Individuals working on any aspect of contracts: contract managers, contract creators, contract negotiators, and contract reviewers.
Refer to the latest XAC release notes for system requirements and supported platforms.
For a comprehensive list of updates to this guide for each release, see the What's New in X-Author for Contracts Advanced topic.

conbody.p: This documentation shows how X-Author for Contracts Advanced works with Conga CLM and Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce), and how you can manage your organization's and your customers' contracts.
To access Conga Platform documentation, select Platform from the dropdown in the upper right menu. To access Salesforce documentation, select Salesforce from the dropdown menu.
